title: Deeper/broader model-document view-style route maturity and NOD-root output gate
mode: Primary project source review and current worktree status reconciliation; plan update
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Cross-check DETAILVIEWSTYLE and SECTIONVIEWSTYLE status against a separate DWG implementation and LibreCAD's bundled-fork inventories.
Determine whether type maturity or generated source inventories establish end-to-end root/object serialization.
Refine the existing same-version DXF raw-replay readiness gate around NOD keys, remapped targets, owners, and failure atomicity.

method.kind: Read-only web-source review plus local plan/worktree status cross-check
method.limitations: LibreDWG master and LibreCAD master source pages are mutable. The LibreCAD inventory is a same-lineage source census and explicitly not byte-level conformance evidence. The local readback failure is recorded from the in-progress implementation worktree state; this research pass did not rerun it.

sources.observed: DETAILVIEWSTYLE and SECTIONVIEWSTYLE are listed as STABLE in the object-name registry and release notes. fixup_NOD() removes ACAD_<type> NOD entries only when is_type_stable(type) is false.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Mutable source-level classification and root-filtering policy only. It does not prove complete field decoding, serialized output correctness, whole-file validity, or native acceptance.

sources.observed: The generated inventory lists the style families as typed read/write routes but marks them fixture-needed, declares itself a deterministic source inventory rather than byte-level conformance, and reports zero validated fixed-object shells. The upgrade plan groups these styles with related model/section objects and calls for typed-plus-raw publication, class identity, and reference-graph closure.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Same libdxfrw lineage and planning/source inventory, not an independent implementation or runtime parity result.

localStatus.existingOwner: PAR-20/7G.3f.4b.2 DETAILVIEWSTYLE/SECTIONVIEWSTYLE capture, reference closure, and same-version DXF raw replay
localStatus.observed: The current generated replay attempt compiles, and readback contains style records plus remapped STYLE/LTYPE/BLOCK_RECORD targets, but the NOD contains only ACAD_GROUP=13 and lacks ACAD_DETAILVIEWSTYLE and ACAD_SECTIONVIEWSTYLE entries.
localStatus.status: INCOMPLETE_ROOTED_OUTPUT; prior in-progress selector failure; not rerun in this research pass

assessment.planEffect: Keep the existing family slice scoped to same-version DXF. Require exact NOD key preservation, unique remapped target resolution, owner closure, unrelated-root retention, ordered raw payload replay, and transactional refusal controls before closing it. Preserve DWG-origin and cross-version refusal until separately qualified.
